args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the v2.3.1 production deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback endpoint was returning 503, so rollback was performed by redeploying v2.3.0. Deployment confirmed and service is now running v2.3.0 in all regions.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Checked deployment history** — found v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions** — the dedicated `rollback` endpoint was returning 503 (unavailable), so I performed the rollback by redeploying v2.3.0, which had already been healthy in production (no change-manager approval needed).
3. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now healthy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west, all running v2.3.0, with a low error rate (0.2%).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, the 503 on the rollback endpoint, and confirmation of recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.
